people.name: Assyria
people.line: A powerful ancient empire, often in conflict with Israel.

translations.web: Behold, you have heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all lands, by destroying them utterly. Will you be delivered?
translations.bsb: Surely you have heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all the other countries, devoting them to destruction. Will you then be spared?
translations.kjv: Behold, thou hast heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all lands, by destroying them utterly: and shalt thou be delivered?
translations.asv: Behold, thou hast heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all lands, by destroying them utterly: and shalt thou be delivered?
